decisive_items: Raynaud’s phenomenon was elicited by cold‐water immersion of the hands
pulmonary arterial systolic pressure (PASP) of 80 mm Hg
response.rationale: Anti-centromere antibody, Raynaud phenomenon, and pulmonary hypertension strongly indicate limited systemic sclerosis (CREST), whereas UCTD lacks this specific autoantibody signature.

rejected.why: Ignores anti-centromere antibody and Raynaud phenomenon; pulmonary hypertension is secondary to scleroderma spectrum.
Rheumatoid factor negative and lacks anti-CCP; polyarthritis is nonspecific.
Only ANA positivity; no SLE-specific features or antibodies.
Less specific than limited systemic sclerosis given anti-centromere and Raynaud findings.
